=== TOOLING NOTES ===
(1) PUSH RACE, first occurrence of this failure mode. A concurrent session pushed 5d738c49 (closing 3 beads + adding 2) mid-run, touching .beads/issues.jsonl -- the exact file tidy mutates. `git reset --hard` is BLOCKED by dcg (core.git:reset-hard), so recovery went: git rebase origin/main -> conflict on issues.jsonl -> `git checkout --ours .beads/issues.jsonl` (in a rebase --ours is the UPSTREAM side, counter-intuitive) -> `br sync` to import their state into our DB -> `br sync --flush-only --force` to export the union. Plain `--flush-only` refuses with 'Nothing to export (no dirty issues)' because dirty-tracking does not notice git reverting the file underneath it; --force is REQUIRED here. Verified the union semantically (jq -S per-id compare vs origin/main) rather than trusting the diffstat: 0 ids removed, 2 added, 39 changed = 32 strips + 2 comments + 2 new + 3 benign. The 3 'benign' are comment surrogate row-ids (3404->3428 etc) that shifted because our comments were inserted before theirs were imported; content byte-identical. HEARTBEAT SHOULD DOCUMENT THIS RECOVERY -- step 6 currently says only 'Slack degraded with the stranded SHA', which would have stranded 32 reconciliations and 2 proposals for no reason. A rebase is not a force-push and does not overwrite the concurrent session.
(2) `$(grep -c ... || echo 0)` is BROKEN in this shell -- grep -c already prints 0 and the fallback appends a second line, yielding '0\n0' and 53 'integer expression expected' errors that silently invalidated the Phase 2a scan on first attempt. Use `|| true`.
(3) `br show <id> --json` returns a BARE ARRAY, not an object -- use `.[0]`. Different shape from `br list --json` ({issues:[]}). Third distinct br JSON shape now documented.
(4) dependent_count is 0 for EVERY epic in this DB and must never be used as the epic predicate; derive epics from the parent-child edge table in issues.jsonl. Tonight that distinction was the difference between 0 and 8 false `unrefined` stamps.
(5) slack-send still has NO --dry-run (FIFTH night reporting). Resolved sofi via infrastructure/slack/channels.json -> C0AQ7964ZU6. Heartbeat step 0 wording remains wrong and should say 'read channels.json'.
(6) git commit -- <pathspec> still fails on untracked files; _plans/_proposals/<date>/ needed explicit git add (FIFTH night; heartbeat step 5 still silent on it).
(7) last-run.json still requires readlink -f + the Write tool (heredoc redirect blocked). FIFTH night.
